posts.name: Dhanwantari Ashokrao Ambatkar
posts.cooked:
I have folder structure, in that I have to find files which contain “config” word.
Could you please help me out to write a grep command to find that files.

Thank you.

posts.name: Dalyodh Singh
posts.cooked:
try this:

ls “foldername” | grep “config”

but first reach to preceding of parent folder where you need to search files to work ls “foldername” in which you wanna search

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Can you clarify a bit more? What do you mean by

23f1002906:

find files which contain “config” word.

Do you mean files that have the word “config” inside the file, or in its file name?

If you mean in the file name then The given solution of

ls | grep 'config'

works.

If you mean find files which contain the text ‘config’ inside it, then use

grep -Hnr config

feel free to also add other regex qualifiers to narrow down your search, for example to only match whole words use grep -Hnr '\bconfig\b'. To match case insensitively use -i flag in grep. To match at start of line use ^ and to match at end of line use $, etc.

Hope that helps.

posts.name: Dhanwantari Ashokrao Ambatkar
posts.cooked:
It is working I was looking for grep -Hnr config where the file contains should be that word
Thank you.
